items.summary: The law to legalise assisted dying in the Isle of Man has received Royal Assent, although no date has yet been agreed for it to be implemented. Assisted dying will allow a person who is terminally ill to choose, in specific circumstances and with strict safeguards in place, to end their life with medical assistance. The Act will not come into force until all practical, clinical and safeguarding arrangements have been agreed. This is a significant and sensitive moment for the Island, but it marks...
